title: tidyr functions
description: Pivoting, completing, filling, separating, nesting, and unnesting, compared with tidyr in R.
reference: R 4.6.1 with dplyr 1.2.1, tidyr 1.3.2, lubridate 1.9.5, and stringr 1.6.0
tolerance: Floating-point table values within 1e-9 relative; all other values equal.
note: n_compared counts the assertions in each test. Errors are over floating-point comparisons; other values must be equal.
